page: Microsoft Azure E48ds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine built on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is powered by a dedicated 4.2 GHz Intel Xeon 8573C processor using the x86_64 architecture. It delivers 48 vCPUs sourced from 24 physical cores with two threads per core. Memory allocation stands at 384.0 GB of RAM, preserving an 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio, backed by 260 MB of L3 cache, 2 MB of L2 cache, and 48 KB of L1d cache. Accelerators such as AVX-512, AMX (Tile and INT8), and cryptographic instruction extensions are present. The instance does not include a GPU but features 2835 GB of bundled local NVMe SSD storage.

Benchmark outcomes demonstrate solid compute and high-density throughput across key domains. The E48ds_v6 achieved a PassMark CPU score of 62,531.31 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 18,086.0, both placing in the top 25%. Instruction vectorization delivers strong results, recording 68,300.48 in PassMark extended instructions and 19,707.0 in Geekbench image processing, which falls into the top 10%. Memory cached read bandwidth reached 3669.37 GB/sec, supporting fast in-memory key-value processing as reflected in 65.36 million Redis SET operations per second. However, uncached large-block write operations (69.83 GB/sec) and general PassMark memory scoring (1705.69) fall into lower percentiles, representing a tradeoff when handling extremely large, uncached working sets.

The combination of 384 GB of memory, fast local NVMe storage, and AMX-enabled vector extensions provides substantial resource density without the premium operational overhead of dedicated GPU acceleration. This profile positions the instance effectively for enterprise in-memory databases, large-scale caching tiers, Clang-based software compilation, and CPU-driven LLM inference across small-to-medium models.
description: Microsoft Azure E48ds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine featuring 48 dedicated vCPUs from a 24-core Intel Xeon 8573C processor clocked at 4.2 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. It is equipped with 384.0 GB of RAM (8.0 GB per vCPU), 260 MB of L3 cache, and 2835 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, without GPU hardware. Benchmark results indicate top-quartile performance across Geekbench multi-core execution (18,086.0), PassMark CPU workloads (62,531.31), and Redis SET operations (65.36 million ops/sec). The presence of AVX-512 and Intel AMX matrix instructions enables efficient CPU-based inference and data processing. While uncached large-block memory writes show mid-tier rates, its high ratio of memory and bundled high-speed local disk make the E48ds_v6 well suited for in-memory databases, large distributed caches, software compilation, and analytical data workloads.
